snippet.title: Isle Goblin - Open Playtest Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Isle Goblin: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688640/Isle_Goblin/

Isle Goblin's first open playtest is now live on Steam! 

The humans have come for your Island, and they’re not leaving quietly. Tasked with turning this war-torn land back into a home, you and your Goblin family must use every tool at your disposal to fight back and rebuild what was once yours.

Published by Fireshine Games and Pocketpair Publishing, and built solo by Watt at Kilowatt Games, who's been developing this one in public, devlog by devlog on his YouTube channel. First real chance to poke around inside Isle Goblin and tell him what's still held together by duct tape.

Isle Goblin Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688640/Isle_Goblin/

--

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
